1) At least 55 people shot, 6 fatally, in 4th of July weekend shootings across Chicago - WLS

2) 12 states have now passed resolutions to add term limits for Congress to the U.S. Constitution. 34 are needed.  These are the states: Florida, Alabama, Missouri, West Virginia, Oklahoma, Wisconsin, Tennessee, Louisiana, North Carolina, South Dakota, Indiana and South Carolina

4) Florida Governor Ron DeSantis calls on Elon Musk to put his resources toward a BALANCED BUDGET and TERM LIMITS FOR CONGRESS amendment and says that would be FAR more successful than a new political party.

5) President Trump to sign executive order delaying the tariff deadlines to Aug 1.

6) President Trump has just officially declared that Japan and South Korea will have a 25% tariff starting on August 1st!

7) Mark Cuban signals he wants to become part of Elon Musk’s new ‘America Party.’

8) Netanyahu has nominated President Trump for the Nobel Peace Prize.

9) President Trump says the US will send more defensive weapons to Ukraine to ensure the Ukrainians can defend themselves while we work to secure a lasting peace.

10) A judge has just issued a temporary restraining order “TRO” halting the implementation of an unambiguous statute—duly enacted by Congress and signed into law by the President—that defunds Planned Parenthood

11) 12 Democrats have been charged with attempted murder after ambushing ICE in Alvarado, Texas. Armed with AR-style rifles, they waited to open fire. Authorities recovered a “Resist Fascism” flag and flyers urging “class war.”

12) Per Secretary McMahon: California has just REJECTED our resolution agreement to follow federal law and keep men out of women's sports. 

13) The Trump administration just announced a complete and total CRACKDOWN on Chinese Communist Party-linked ownership of FARMLAND nationwide.

14) Former CIA officer alleges that the “Deep State” likely destroyed the Epstein files.

15) At least 104 people killed (28 children) in the Texas floods, with dozens still missing.

16) Elon Musk claims Steve Bannon is in the "Epstein files." 

17) The Supreme Court allows Trump administration to move forward with plans to downsize the federal workforce with mass layoffs.

18) FBI launches criminal investigations of John Brennan and James Comey over Trump-Russia probe.

19) Elon Musk posted on X that it would be an America Party top priority to release the Epstein List. (That supposedly doesn't exist.)

20) Florida has renamed a four mile stretch of Southern Boulevard in Palm Beach County to "President Donald J. Trump Boulevard."   

21) The DOJ has charged two North Carolina residents, Tina Brown Cooper and Ronnie Jay Oxendine, for helping Ryan Routh obtain a rifle in his plot to assassinate President Trump.

22) Former President Joe Biden’s physician, Dr. Kevin O’Connor, has INVOKED THE FIFTH AMENDMENT during a closed-door congressional deposition.

23) Federal Reserve Chairman, Jerome Powell, is supposedly resigning.

24) Linda Yaccarino steps down as the CEO of X.

25) President Trump announced more Tariffs effective August 1st: 30% tariff rate against Algeria, a 25% rate against Brunei, a 30% rate against Iraq, a 30% rate against Libya, a 25% rate against Moldova and a 20% rate against the Philippines.

26) The Trump administration sues California for refusing to ban transgender athletes.

27) Germany to import more LNG from the US, making America its biggest supplier.

28) 6 Secret Service agents suspended over conduct during attempted Trump assassination.

29) The Trump administration sues California over price of eggs.

30) Donald Trump announced Wednesday evening that Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy will also serve temporarily as the head of NASA.

31) Steve Baker of The Blaze insinuates that the FBI is calling media members and telling them to back off the Epstein case or lose access.

32) Austin Fire Chief accused of refusing to send rescue teams to Kerrville days before deadly floods.

33) A district judge has blocked President Trump’s order to end birthright citizenship for criminal aliens.

34) Judicial Watch reports that the DOJ and FBI are still in the process of locating and reviewing Jeffrey Epstein-related records as part of their ongoing lawsuit, contradicting the memo sent out.

35) Prince Andrew now free to travel internationally as the FBI ends its investigation into his ties with Jeffrey Epstein.

36) Senator Ron Johnson readies subpoenas for FBI, DOJ in Butler shooting probe.

37) Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth Removes Top Navy Admiral, Machael "Buzz" Donnelly, who Allowed Drag Shows on an Aircraft Carrier.

38) Trump administration bans illegal immigrants from taxpayer-funded services, including Head Start.

39) Trump taps Transportation secretary Sean Duffy to serve as interim NASA chief.

40) Mahmoud Khalil files $20 million lawsuit against the Trump administration.

41) Trump threatens to withhold endorsement for Republicans who oppose his rescissions package.

42) Biden-appointed judge, Maame Ewusi-Mensah Frimpong, has just made a ruling that marks Home Depots, car washes, and other locations where illegals hide as safe havens in LA blocking ICE from making arrests at those locations.

43) President Trump’s Education Department Ends Free Tuition for Illegal Immigrants.

44) FBI deputy director Dan Bongino took a day off from work after a White House clash with AG Pam Bondi over handling of the Jeffrey Epstein files — Axios.

45) California Gov. Newsom donor's cannabis farm under federal investigation for 'child labor violations.

46) Congressman Jamie Raskin is going to ask Chairman Jordan for a hearing and to subpoena Pam Bondi, Kash Patel and Dan Bongino about the Epstein Files.

47) US customs duties reach record $27 billion in June, spurring a small surplus.

48) Pam Bondi orders The DOJ to dismiss all charges against Dr. Kirk Moore.

49) AG Pam Bondi OFFICIALLY FIRES 20 DOJ employees from Jan. 6, Trump documents cases.

50) Kristi Noem announced FIVE MORE Alligator Alcatraz-style detention centers are in the works.

51) California Rep. Ro Khanna to introduce amendment that will FORCE A VOTE demanding the FULL Epstein files be publicly released. In this scenario, Speaker Mike Johnson would have to call a vote that would put every single  member on record.
